response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_q FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS overall_avg FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_q AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_q - overall.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM o CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_q - overall.overall_avg) IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10
